subject: Request: Praxis Labs pilot top-up + commit sweetener
messages:
From: Anya Patel <anya@praxislabs.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Praxis pilot — short runway, ask for top-up + commit sweetener

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed by the latency profile and the ease of the private deployment option. We’re ready to move from an exploratory POC to a short production pilot, but we’re tight on runway for the fiscal quarter. Two asks: 1) a one-time top-up of 150k free tokens to make sure the pilot can cover the burst phases during integration; and 2) a small promotional commit sweetener (1 month of reduced unit pricing) if we commit to a 6-month pilot within the next 30 days.

Attached is a short usage forecast and the latest MSA redline from our legal team. Can you confirm if Redwood can accommodate this? Our procurement lead (cc’d to legal) needs an answer this week to keep timing.

Looking forward,
Anya

Attachments: Praxis_Pilot_Usage_Forecast.xlsx, Praxis-MSA-redline.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Anya Patel <anya@praxislabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Praxis pilot — short runway, ask for top-up + commit sweetener

Anya — appreciate the fast follow. I’ve looped in Marissa on PS/onboarding and Naomi for finance. High-level: Redistributing credits is doable but beyond our standard starter top-up; the commit sweetener is something that usually requires exec sign-off because it impacts blended ARPU.

Internal ask (Marissa / Naomi): can we outline the delta to standard terms if we grant 150k token top-up and a 1-month reduced rate tied to a 6-month pilot commit? Please include the revenue math (standalone vs. blended), any risk to our capacity commitments, and the simplest contractual language to bind the promo.

Anya — we’ll respond with a concrete proposal within 48 hours.

Best,
Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Anya Patel <anya@praxislabs.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Praxis pilot — short runway, ask for top-up + commit sweetener

Karthik / Naomi — quick operational notes and suggestions:  
- We can issue a one-time credit pack (150k tokens) to the Praxis tenant that expires at pilot end (6 months) — low operational risk.
- For the pricing sweetener, propose: 20% off for the first month of the pilot on the committed baseline (applies only to committed tokens, not overage). This is non-recurring and tied to signed pilot SOW within 30 days.
- Contract language: short addendum to SOW with a clause "Non-recurring promotional pricing: 20% off for billing month 1 on committed baseline if SOW signed within 30 days." Legal can use that and Praxis legal can sign the addendum.

Anya — if that looks acceptable, we’ll prepare the addendum and the credit issuance instructions. Naomi — can you confirm revenue / P&L delta so Karthik can present to Aditya?

-Marissa

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Anya Patel <anya@praxislabs.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 12:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Praxis pilot — short runway, ask for top-up + commit sweetener

Quick finance view:
- Base pilot commit proposed: $60k/month (estimated committed tokens).
- Issuing a 150k token credit ~ translates to ~$3,000 revenue reduction at our list price if consumed fully (we assume ~20 tokens/req pricing basis here).
- 20% off for the first month on $60k = $12k discount. Total one-time hit = $15k.
- Upside: if they convert to a paid contract post-pilot (50% chance based on rep intel), expected LTV > 6x.

Recommendation: Approve conditionally if we can require (1) SOW signed within 30 days and (2) explicit conversion review at month 5 with a renew/expand exec check. If approved, we need Aditya signoff for >$10k one-time promotional hits.

-Naomi

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Praxis pilot — short runway, ask for top-up + commit sweetener

Thanks team — I reviewed. Approve the request with the following guardrails:  
1) Issue the 150k one-time credit to Praxis tenant, expiration aligned with the 6-month pilot end date.
2) Apply 20% promo to month 1 on the committed baseline only. No overage discounts.
3) SOW must be fully executed within 30 days; attach a one-line addendum for the promo to the SOW.
4) Schedule a formal conversion review (internal) at pilot month 5 — Karthik to lead and invite Revenue Ops + Finance.
5) Cap total one-time promotional impact at $18k; Naomi, you have authority to finalize details within that cap.

Karthik / Marissa — communicate these terms to Praxis and attach the addendum and credit issuance plan. Please copy me on the confirmation email and the DocuSign envelope once routed.

—Aditya
